member.name: M:TreeYield.Core.Services.YieldCalculator.Calculate(TreeYield.Core.Models.TreeSpecies,System.Int32)
member.summary:
Calculates the yearly yield and gross sales at full production.
Annual yield = tree count x yield per tree per year.
Gross sales = annual yield x price per unit. Example: 25 Carabao Mango trees x 300 kg = 7,500 kg; 7,500 kg x PHP 80 = PHP 600,000.
member.param: The species to calculate. Must not be null.
member.exception: treeCount is outside the allowed range.

member.name: M:TreeYield.Core.Services.YieldCalculator.GetProductionFactor(TreeYield.Core.Models.TreeSpecies,System.Int32)
member.summary:
Returns how much of full production an annual species reaches in a given year after planting, as a fraction from 0 to 1.
Before the first harvest year the trees are still growing: 0.
From the first harvest to full production the yield rises in equal steps (linear ramp).
From the full-production year onward: 1 (100%).
Example: first harvest in year 5, full production in year 8 gives 25%, 50%, 75% and 100% for years 5, 6, 7 and 8.
member.param: The species. Must not be null.

member.name: M:TreeYield.Core.Services.YieldCalculator.Project(TreeYield.Core.Models.TreeSpecies,System.Int32,System.Int32)
member.summary: Builds a year-by-year projection of yield and gross sales. Annual species follow . Rotation species earn nothing until rotation age and then the whole stand is cut; the projection assumes the land is replanted at once, so harvests repeat every rotation.
member.param: The species. Must not be null.
